notes.title: Patch Note 0.7.4.6 - Change defense / receive system
notes.content:
Hi everyone,


Little update to change the defense/receive system.

[h1][b]NEW SYSTEM[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Long balls : instead of having to hold BACKWARD and press A, you just have to press BACKWARD
[*] Middle balls : no change (you press A to bump)
[*] Short balls : instead of having to hold FORWARD and press A, you just have to press FORWARD
[/list]

I know some of you could prefer the old system but it makes things way easier in the long run with this new system especially for fast plays where having to press A was a mess.
It will also avoid the "oh I pressed A before the arrow..." moments.


Have a nice day ♥
Joé

notes.title: Patch Note 0.7.2 - MyClub mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350752/37c9dab1b76c94b5630482eb3eb0883a6dab7022.png[/img]

Hi Everyone !

First of all, Happy New Year everyone ♥
It's been a while because I put only big update patch note on Steam and the little updates + hot fix are all on Discord.

SO ! Do you want all the patch notes here or only the big updates ?
answer in this poll please :
[url=https://linkto.run/p/U1G2F5Q6]click here to vote[/url]

Now, let's talk about this update :D

[h1]BIG STUFF[/h1]
MyClub is back !
- recruit new players
- prepare your team
- play matches in a big championship with 4 divisions
- players might retire at the end of the year
- players are trained every week

Game
- new system to calculate defense/receives results (based on timing + players's characteristics)
- SPEED characteristic is the in the game and will impact actions
- you can now press BUMP again to restart the BUMP

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
- GAME - defender will stay a bit longer when defending deep ball
- GAME - AI will serve harder (in high difficulty levels)
- GAME - AI will serve easier (in low difficulty levels)
- GAME - AI easy will be easier
- GAME - AI will block far from net sometimes
- GAME - AI will receive float serves better
- GAME - long tip will be a bit slower
- GAME - long spike far from net can miss the hands of the blocker
- GAME - timing will matter more for the serve
- GAME - system QoL to avoid direction not counting when pressing direction + A/B
- GAME - middle blocker will be more on the ball trajectory
- TUTORIAL - add a prompt to indicate that you can spike without direction (LEFT / RIGHT)
- EDITOR/MYCLUB - random players will be more realistic
- EDITOR - black shadow for accessories
- EDITOR - randomize jersey/short colors
- EDITOR - new music for editor menus
- SETTINGS - button reset default for audio volumes
- SETTINGS - camera shake slider
- SETTINGS - gamepad rumble slider

- TEAMS - Team Argentina (thanks to Dynezel)

[h1]BUGS FIXED[/h1]
- GAME - picking a team with a deleted player won't break the game

- GAME - the ball will touch the floor properly
- GAME - jump of defenders based on hitter
- GAME -  AI not receiving long serves on the line

Thank you for reading and I hope you're enjoying the game ♥

notes.title: Devlog #4 Demo incoming
notes.content:
Hi everyone,


[h3][b]Block out[/b][/h3]
You know this feeling when the guy in front of you is WAY TOO TALL and keeps blocking you ? Hinata does.
We didn't like it so we added the possibility to imitate our icon : THE LITTLE GIANT !
You can now hit hard high hands and if the guy try to block you, it will results as a block out :D
But be carefull with this technique because without the block, your ball will go out xD

[h3][b]SlowMotion[/b][/h3]
We added slowmotion on the last points of the game. The feeling to win/lose is way stronger now ♥

[h3][b]Effects[/b][/h3]
We added VFX in the game :
[list]
[*] ring when you spike the ball
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350752/6a4cd719bc38b3b95f1905b5f5089f42af1a052f.png[/img]

[*] impact when you block/pass the ball[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350752/334b045faf732dcbf782e0d3f82f03f150df6c83.png[/img]

[*] smoke when the ball hits the ground
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350752/7f97d0d2a1a7bb6f30873f75c006e457499505e5.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3][b]Steam Next Fest[/b][/h3]
We worked hard and the game is ready for his first show. Spikair Volleyball will be part of Steam Next Fest which will start in just 2 weeks !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350752/46430e9253fc0c2668886767e96a6772086832d6.png[/img]

[h3][b]Demo Content[/b][/h3]
You'll have little tutorials to understand how to :
[list]
[*] serve
[*] attack
[*] set
[*] block
[*] pass
[/list]

Then it's time for you to play a game against your own computer (yeah, it's a terrible fate, isn't it ?).

With this demo, we want to have our second big contact with the community after the Alpha Version which is still available here :
https://le-jo.itch.io/spikair-volleyball-alpha

The game changed a lot and we hope you'll like it even more ♥

To have more news, you can follow us on twitter :
@ChocAbyss

We can't wait to see what you will think of the game ! As always, you can contact us in the Steam forum ♥

P-S : the doors of the Official Discord will open really soon ! :D

notes.title: Devlog #1 from 2D to 3D
notes.content:
We worked well the last weeks and we reach a big goal for us :
From Alpha version, we're now in [b]Beta version[/b] !

It's mostly about [b]visual[/b]. The game is now in [b]3D[/b]. We want to keep [b]pixel art 2D[/b] so players and other stuff will stay 2D sprites but [b]FX, shadows[/b] and other stuff are now much more enjoyable to watch ;)

To show the progress, we update the Steam page with few [b]screenshots[/b] and a new [b]trailer[/b] :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350752/c4f07a2526f9cf4732399f4509accd6edfbae090.png[/img]
